name: Banded hare-wallaby
desc: A nocturnal vegetarian that shelters in dense thickets, favouring dune wattle scrub. Natural populations survive only on Bernier and Dorre islands; reintroduced to Dirk Hartog Island.
about: The banded hare-wallaby, mernine, or munning is a marsupial currently found on the islands of Bernier and Dorre off western Australia.
